cards.title: RegRAG — RBI Banking-Regulation RAG Benchmark
cards.desc: Question answering over RBI Master Directions with page citations, and a benchmark of six RAG designs on the same questions. An evidence gate abstains with "not found" when the documents do not support an answer. Early development.
cards.result: Hybrid retrieval recall@5 0.92 on 26 questions · 6 pipelines compared · full benchmark in progress

cards.title: Voice Agent Audit — Evaluating a Hinglish Voice Agent
cards.desc: Evaluation kit for a Hinglish payment-reminder voice agent: rule checks, an LLM judge checked against human labels, and hybrid retrieval over a pgvector policy corpus, served with FastAPI, Redis and Langfuse tracing.
cards.result: 43.5% fewer prompt tokens · 119/120 correct actions · retrieval recall@3 0.53

cards.title: Sanwaad — Multi-Agent Complaint Resolution
cards.desc: Multi-agent system that turns public complaints into resolved cases. LangGraph pipeline with hybrid RAG, policy-grounded replies, and human approval on every money action. 472 tests and trace-level evals.
cards.result: 15/15 trajectory scenarios passed · 0 safety violations · retrieval recall@5 1.00

cards.title: LMA Clause Identification Tool
cards.desc: Production NLP pipeline on Dataiku DSS identifying legal clauses in loan agreements. Fine-tuned DistilBERT + SBERT semantic search with confidence thresholding.

cards.title: AutoTransFlow
cards.desc: Multilingual document translation preserving original PDF layout. doc-layout-yolo detects text blocks with bounding boxes; NLLB-200 translates 200 languages locally.
cards.result: Layout-preserving translation · 200 languages · Zero external API calls

cards.title: RAG Chatbot
cards.desc: Production retrieval-augmented generation chatbot. LangChain pipeline with FAISS vector database, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, and StableLM Zephyr 3B for grounded answers.
cards.result: Multi-turn dialogue · Grounded answers · PDF knowledge base

cards.title: Medical Bill OCR & Fraud Detection
cards.desc: End-to-end datathon pipeline: OpenCV preprocessing → PaddleOCR → Qwen 7B extraction → 4 automated fraud checks (IQR, reconciliation, SHA-256 hashing, pattern analysis).

cards.title: Multilingual ASR System
cards.desc: Zero-shot Urdu speech recognition using Whisper. Audio preprocessing pipeline with pydub and librosa, IndicBERT MLM corrector for post-ASR error fixing.
cards.result: ↓ 14% Word Error Rate · Zero-shot Urdu recognition

cards.title: Market Analysis Using LLMs
cards.desc: Financial news sentiment pipeline. BeautifulSoup scraping → two-pass BART summarisation → RoBERTa sentiment → SMOTE balancing → Flask API with Streamlit dashboard.

cards.title: OpsAgent — Autonomous Browser Operator
cards.desc: AI agent that completes back-office tasks in a real browser using a plan-act-verify loop. Approval gates enforced in code, and an independent verifier that re-reads the ERP without an LLM.
cards.result: 11/12 eval scenarios passed · about $0.03 per run · approval gates in code

cards.title: Audit Insight — NLP Analytics
cards.desc: End-to-end NLP pipeline for audit text analysis. RoBERTa sentiment classification, Gensim LDA topic modeling, KMeans clustering with t-SNE visualization, and Streamlit dashboard.

cards.title: Career Copilot 2.0
cards.desc: AI-powered job search operating system. RAG matching with FAISS, response prediction, hidden market radar, ATS optimization, and 11 intelligent modules. Built with Streamlit + LangChain + Groq LLaMA 3.
cards.result: 11 AI modules · Complete career operating system

cards.title: AirFare-ML
cards.desc: End-to-end airline ticket price prediction. 6 regression algorithms benchmarked with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization. LightGBM achieves 93.9% R² with ₹689 MAE.

cards.title: Hastkala Setu
cards.desc: Dual-component BITS design project: ML pipeline for cross-cultural conflict resolution (MANOVA, XGBoost, SHAP) + Flutter mobile app for Indian handicraft artisans with Hindi voice input.

cards.title: Road Safety NLP Analysis
cards.desc: NLP-based classification of road accident severity from news articles. Multi-source scraping pipeline with spaCy NER for location extraction and severity classification across 8 Hyderabad news outlets.
cards.result: 8 news sources · Severity classification · NER location extraction

cards.title: HydRERA Analytics
cards.desc: End-to-end real estate analytics platform. ELT pipeline (Python → PostgreSQL → dbt) producing builder reliability scorecards, supply-demand tracking, price fairness analysis, and delay prediction with SHAP.
cards.result: 4 analytical modules · Builder scorecards · Delay prediction

cards.title: Knowledge Graph RAG for Legal AI
cards.desc: Hybrid KG+RAG system for Indian Supreme Court case analysis. Neo4j legal knowledge graph with 1,000 cases, Vespa hybrid search (BM25 + InLegalBERT), and IRAC-constrained LLM reasoning with Mistral 7B.
cards.result: 1,000 cases · IRAC reasoning · KG vs GraphMERT benchmark

cards.title: StemCells DBMS
cards.desc: Full-stack donor, patient, hospital, and staff management system. Flask + MySQL backend with dynamic dashboard that tracks entity counts in real-time as new registrations occur.
cards.result: Dynamic dashboard · CRUD operations · Real-time counts

bullets: Built a production Gemini Live voice agent on Pipecat and FastAPI, serving 5 client deployments across 10 languages
Moved negotiation rules out of the prompt into a deterministic Python gate that approves or refuses the model's tool calls before it speaks
Test every model change against about 1,300 checks across five suites, plus a 500-call borrower simulator and a 17-persona text simulator
Measure agent variants with A/B control arms, isolating behaviour shifts before a production release
Cut per-turn prompt cost 79% to 3,490 tokens by moving situational context into tool responses
Mined 36,091 call records down to 12 curated training scenes; audited 26 human collector calls against RBI norms and locked 9 prohibited practices into the agent
Mapped an exporter's manual order-to-cash process into a documented 4-phase Odoo 19 workflow
Configured field-level data rules across 6 process stages, agreeing each with the operations owners

experience.org: Standard Chartered Global Business Services · Bangalore
bullets: Engineered NLP pipelines on Dataiku DSS to process 100+ page LMA agreements, cutting manual audit times by 90% for compliance teams
Fine-tuned DistilBERT with WeightedTrainer (20x class weight boost) achieving 98.6% recall on rare legal clauses despite 90%+ irrelevant text
Fine-tuned SBERT with MultipleNegativesRankingLoss for semantic search — retrieved gold-standard compliance language via cosine similarity
Deployed confidence thresholding (minimum correct confidence method) filtering 95%+ false positives for audit-grade precision
Built AutoTransFlow: multilingual PDF translation using doc-layout-yolo + NLLB-200, preserving original document layout without external APIs
Built production RAG chatbot: LangChain loaders → RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter → all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings → FAISS → StableLM Zephyr 3B
Implemented ConversationalRetrievalChain with ConversationBufferMemory for multi-turn dialogue with proprietary PDF documents
Integrated speech and NLP models for analytics automation; scraped and processed 500+ articles via BeautifulSoup
